name: Hu Moment Invariants
description: Computes Hu's seven moment invariants to detect shape and rotation anomalies in AI content (Hu, 1962).
mechanism:
The Hu Moment Invariants system analyzes specific signal patterns to distinguish AI-generated content from authentic media.

1. **Feature Extraction**: Extracts relevant features from input data.
2. **Statistical Analysis**: Computes statistical measures and compares against known baselines.
3. **Score Computation**: Generates a confidence score based on detected anomalies.
parameters: Analysis type: automated statistical\nScore range: 0 (authentic) to 100 (AI-generated)\nMinimum input size: varies by media type
accuracy: Moderate to High — 70-85% accuracy depending on input quality and method combination.
source: Based on peer-reviewed research in digital forensics and AI content detection.
useCase: Used as part of multi-signal analysis pipeline to detect AI-generated content.
strengths:
• Research-backed methodology
• Fast computation time
• Complementary to other detection methods
• Works across different AI generators
limitations: • Accuracy varies with input quality\n• Best used in combination with other methods\n• May require calibration for new AI models

references.title: Hu, M.K. (1962). Visual Pattern Recognition by Moment Invariants. IRE Trans. Information Theory.
Flusser, J. et al. (2009). Moments and Moment Invariants in Pattern Recognition. Wiley.
